lead.en: A measured read of an existing site: what loads, what is requested from third parties, what a visitor without JavaScript sees, and what a screen reader announces.

text.en: Lighthouse mobile scores, layout shift and blocking time, with the test date and device profile stated.
Every request that leaves the site's own origin, with its purpose.
Whether the real content is in the HTML.
Automated checks plus keyboard and mobile-menu walkthroughs.
Content-Security-Policy, transport security, robots and sitemap behaviour.
A dated report with each finding, how to reproduce it, and what it would take to fix it. Automated tools find only part of the problems, and the report says which parts were not checked.
Every claim on this site is dated, and every limit declared.
